entries.title: Yooba Land is Yooba's origin: eat, grow, and find the way home
entries.body: Yooba is a gooey character (two extra jumps and a long-reach mouth when he fights in Dose Of Destruction). Older Sick Of It blog lore has Yooba as a farmer whose village the Overlord burned.

entries.title: The Place Department: where things that should not exist are given an address
entries.body: The current build (breakingthrough) is Warrok, a bow-wielding brute, defending a pirate pianist from waves of birds.

entries.title: The Final Spark starts in a sewer, found by a rat
entries.body: A choose-your-path video story: each choice is a page with a video. Touching the green sludge ends the run ("Try again in another life"). The tree is TheFinalSpark/Decision tree.txt.

entries.body: Simulated in real time from day.config.js. Its direction is undecided: don't invent one.
